2.I: Vendor stays PENDING_APPROVAL; fix and resubmit (submission_number + 1)

3.E: Always, or when rfq_estimated_total_amount reaches a configured threshold

3.I: rfq_status stays DRAFT; buyer revises and resubmits

4.H: rfq_status becomes AWARDED; rfq_lines.is_awarded set; PO can be created (purchase_order_header.rfq_id)

5.F: Tier 1: Purchasing Manager. Tier 2: + Finance Manager. Tier 3: + Director / CFO

6.F: Warehouse Manager (+ Purchasing for price variance)

14.A: Approval rules (apply to every document type)

15.A: 1. Resolution: when a document is submitted, pick the active approval_workflows row with the same approval_document_type, matching company / branch, amount inside [approval_min_amount, approval_max_amount) and approval_condition satisfied; the lowest approval_priority wins. No match = approval_status NOT_REQUIRED.

16.A: 2. Submission: creates an approval_requests row (approval_submission_number = 1), snapshots approval_amount and sets the header approval_status to PENDING and approval_request_id to the new row.

17.A: 3. Steps run in approval_step_number order. approval_mode ANY_ONE needs one approval; ALL needs approval_min_approvals. Every decision is one append-only approval_actions row.

18.A: 4. Segregation of duties: the document creator cannot approve their own document unless approval_workflow_steps.is_self_approval_allowed = TRUE.

19.A: 5. REJECTED or RETURNED: the document stays at its pre-approval lifecycle status. After revision the user resubmits and a new approval_requests row is created with approval_submission_number + 1.

20.A: 6. APPROVED: header approval_status = APPROVED; the lifecycle action in the matrix becomes allowed (issue, send, post, release). Approval never changes lifecycle status by itself.

21.A: 7. Posting to inventory_ledger / stock_balances (receipt, issue, adjustment, waste, work order output) is only allowed when approval_status is NOT_REQUIRED or APPROVED.

22.A: 8. A document is locked while its approval is PENDING. Material edits to an APPROVED document (e.g., PO total) cancel the old request and force a new one.

23.A: 9. SLA: when approval_sla_hours expires the step is ESCALATED to escalation_user_id (logged as an approval_actions row).

24.A: 10. Thresholds, chains and conditions are rows in approval_workflows / approval_workflow_steps, never hard-coded in the application.
